newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania cen.bank one-week rate up to 52.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania cen.bank one-week rate up to 52.75 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Romania (BNR) saw its one-week refinancing rate rise to 52.75 percent from last week's 50.19 percent following an oversubscription at auction for its weekly funds.
Money market short-term prices rose some 1.0 percent up toward 50-51 percent, traders said.
But some operators said rates for money market funds up to one-week were unlikely to break higher.
Two banks bid a total of 500 billion lei at rates ranging from 49 to 55 percent for 400 billion lei worth of BNR funds.
